title: Herbal Juicy German Baby Pak Koi Stew
description: A comforting, diabetic-friendly stew featuring tender baby pak koi and a blend of herbal flavors, perfect for a sick day. This German-inspired dish utilizes sous-vide cooking for optimal texture and flavor.

ingredients.name: baby pak koi
ingredients.notes: also known as baby bok choy

instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine caraway seeds, thyme, parsley, lemon juice, and garlic. Blend until well combined.
In a large bowl, whisk together the chicken broth, blended herbal mixture, and olive oil.
Add the baby pak koi to a large sous-vide bag or a heat-proof container with a lid. Pour the broth mixture over the pak koi.
Seal the bag or cover the container with a lid. Cook in the sous-vide machine for 1 hour.
While the pak koi is cooking, slice the onion into thin rings.
After 1 hour, remove the pak koi from the sous-vide machine and stir in the sliced onion.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Store any leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
